topics.label: Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the final lecture on cancer therapy and outlines the core learning objectives.

topics.label: Conventional Cancer Therapies and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine conventional non-targeted therapeutic modalities along with their mechanisms of toxicity and resistance.

topics.label: Exploiting Checkpoint Loss and DNA Repair Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss therapeutic strategies that exploit intrinsic tumor vulnerabilities arising from defective cell cycle checkpoints and DNA repair pathways.

topics.label: Oncogene Addiction and Kinase Inhibitors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address targeted therapies directed against hyperactive oncogenic kinases and the cellular mechanisms that drive drug resistance.

topics.label: Antibody-Based Therapies and Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the therapeutic application of tumor-targeting monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates.

topics.label: Immune Checkpoint Blockade and Cellular Immunotherapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine tumor immunology and explore methods to activate or engineer patient T-cell responses against cancer cells.

topics.label: Therapeutic Challenges, Progress, and Future Outlook
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess the overarching clinical challenges, historical progress, and future directions of modern cancer medicine.
